#### Section 9: Asset funding boost (when asset fully funded)  
- Formula: `boost = min(5%, 2% + raiseAmount/1M × 3%)` (displayed in a rounded rectangle).  

#### Section: Price history  
- Text: `Price history is recorded in the price_history table for charting.` (with `price_history` in purple).  

#### Section 10: Fee Structure  
- Table with columns: `Fee Type`, `Rate`, `Collected By`:  
  | Fee Type          | Rate                          | Collected By                     |  
  |-------------------|-------------------------------|----------------------------------|  
  | Trading fee       | 0.1% per trade (both sides)    | `__PLATFORM_FEE__ wallet`         |  
  | Asset listing fee | 1.0 AC                        | (configured, not currently enforced) |  
  | Capital raise fee | 1.0% of raised amount         | Deducted from escrow payout       |  
  | Withdrawal fee    | 0.5 AC                        | Sent to `__PLATFORM_FEE__ wallet` |  
  | Gateway fees      | Varies by gateway             | Deducted from fiat amount        |  
- Text: `All fees are recorded in the fee_ledger table and aggregated in economy.total_fees_collected.` (with `fee_ledger` and `economy.total_fees_collected` in purple).

- Title only (no content).

### Page 27 (27/32)  
**Header**: Timestamp `2/16/2025, 10:54 AM`; Title `Averon v4.0.0 — System Architecture Walkthrough`  

#### Section 11: Security Model (Table)  
- Columns: `Aspect`, `Implementation`:  
  | Aspect                  | Implementation                                                                 |  
  |-------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|  
  | Password storage        | PBKDF2-SHA512, 100K iterations, 32-byte random salt                             |  
  | JWT tokens              | HMAC-SHA256, zero-dependency, short-lived access (15min)                         |  
  | Blockchain signing      | ECDSA secp256k1 (Bitcoin-grade)                                                |  
  | Audit trail             | SHA-256 hash-chained, tamper-detectable                                        |  
  | Rate limiting           | 4-tier token bucket (100/10/5/10 req per window)                                 |  
  | Input sanitization      | HTML entity stripping, length limits                                           |  
  | Account lockout         | 5 failed logins → 15-minute lock                                               |  
  | Account freezing        | Admin can freeze any account                                                   |  
  | Double-mint prevention  | Atomic DB status lock before minting                                           |  
  | Race condition protection | `UPDATE WHERE owner_id IS NULL` for token claims (SQL snippet in purple)        |  
  | Webhook verification    | HMAC signature validation (Razorpay/Stripe)                                     |  
  | Circuit breaker         | 10% price move in 1 hour halts trading                                          |  
  | KYC/AML                 | 4-tier limits + 8 AML flag types, blocks at 3+ flags                             |  
  | Security headers        | Helmet.js (CSP, HSTS, XSS protection)                                          |  
  | CORS                    | Configurable allowed origins                                                   |  

**Footer**: `file:///D:/Averon/averon_system_architecture.html` | `27/32`  


### Page 28 (28/32)  
**Header**: Timestamp `2/16/2025, 10:54 AM`; Title `Averon v4.0.0 — System Architecture Walkthrough`  

#### Section 12: Deployment Architecture  
- **Development**:  
  - Code snippet: `npm run dev # Node --watch mode (auto-restart on changes)` (in a rounded rectangle).  
- **Production (PM2)**:  
  - Code snippet: `npm run production # PM2 cluster mode with ecosystem.config.js # Auto-forks N workers (= CPU count) # Auto-restarts on crash` (in a rounded rectangle).  
- **Docker**:  
  - Code snippet: `docker compose up -d # Single container, health checks every 15s # 1GB memory limit, 256MB reserved # Persistent volumes for data/ and uploads/` (in a rounded rectangle).  
- **Cluster mode (production)**:  
  - Text: `The primary process forks N workers using cluster module. Each worker runs the full Express app independently. Workers auto-restart on crash. Graceful shutdown propagates SIGTERM to all workers.` (with `cluster` and `SIGTERM` in purple).
